_about: Extension pack: searching across Europe (EU, EEA, Switzerland, the UK) beyond a home market. List it after your home pack in profile.json, e.g. "regions": ["de", "eu"]: the first pack is the home market, this one widens the scope and adds route rules for the other countries. Route adjustments assume a NON-EU applicant who studies or lives in the home country; an EU citizen needs none (profile work_authorization.status = eu_citizen).
name: Europe (EU, EEA, Switzerland, UK)

routes.eu_erasmus: EU, Erasmus+ placement or study-mobility route
routes.national_rules: Country's own national rules (Directive not applied)

route_rules.note: Denmark and Ireland do not apply Directive 2016/801: purely national rules; routes exist but not under the EU mobility rules (-2)
Outside the Directive: own national rules and quotas; a thesis that is a mandatory part of the degree is the easiest case (-2)
Outside the Directive: own national rules and tight quotas for non-EU nationals (-3)
Thesis in another EU state: a legal path exists (Art. 31 Directive 2016/801 plus host rules) but needs the university's sign-off, a host notification and a valid permit for the whole stay (-1)
Placement in another EU state: Erasmus+ or study-mobility route with the university's sign-off and the host state's answer; whether a traineeship counts as study is decided state by state (-1)
A career role abroad needs an employer-sponsored permit (skilled-worker or Blue Card route, salary thresholds differ per country): -3 unless the posting says it sponsors
Needs the host country's work permit: no named route (-3)

route_default.note: A role in another country with no stated route for a non-EU applicant (-3)
